answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/tipping, the complete 2026-11-07 capture states the goal of customizing suggestions displayed on the reader and offers Dashboard and API variants, with no configuration prerequisites, actor roles or state transitions in those 14 lines (new raw lines 5-14). The 2026-05-01 capture says the reader displays three amounts or percentages before the customer presents a payment method. Smart tips switch between those types based on pre-tip amount; the two other modes are three percentage or fixed amounts. A fleet operator can edit or override Tipping for a location in Dashboard, choose mode and currency, then Review, Confirm and Apply changes, with application on the reader within 10 minutes in that guide section. An API integration can create or update a Configuration with currency-keyed tipping settings; the USD example includes percentages, fixed_amounts and smart_tip_threshold (old raw lines 8-12, old raw lines 18-41, old raw lines 43-88). source-stripe-terminal-tipping-config preserves the API fields and modes but needs the dated Dashboard route and more precise reader timing and USD example qualifiers.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/tipping, add dated raw-reference navigation in source-stripe-terminal-tipping-config for https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/tipping.md?dashboard-or-api=dashboard and https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/tipping.md?dashboard-or-api=api. The index is presentational/navigation with no demonstrated change to the linked implementation bodies (old raw lines 14-16, old raw lines 43-47; new raw lines 5-14). Preserve the May 1 Dashboard location paths and within-10-minute timing in scope, and identify the stray 'passcode' word as an editorial inconsistency in the Tipping steps. The explicit USD configuration is a sample rather than a universal cents contract (old raw lines 18-41, old raw lines 47-85). Keep the reciprocal stripe-terminal-tipping concept route and route to the separate on-reader and Configuration sources: the on-reader guide shows fixed amounts below the USD threshold and percentages at/above, plus distinct reader propagation (raw/stripe-terminal-features-collecting-tips-on-reader-2026-11-07.md lines 92-98 and 128-130), while the separate configuration guide supports account defaults and location overrides (raw/stripe-terminal-configurations-2025.md lines 8-26). Keep on-receipt tipping as a separate feature.
